title: Extended Core - C
texts: A core workout designed to develop body tension in extended positions
Leg Raise to Front Lever Eccentric
Leg Raise to Front Lever Eccentric
Jack Knife to Reverse Prone I
Jack Knife to Reverse Prone I
Leg Raise to Front Lever Eccentric
Leg Raise to Front Lever Eccentric
Jack Knife to Reverse Prone I
Jack Knife to Reverse Prone I

Complete all sets and reps for each exercise in order. Rest for 2 minutes between sets and exercises.

Hanging Leg raises to lever lift eccentric - From a hanging position lift your toes to the bar with straight legs, extend at the hips to point your toes towards the ceiling, and then lower through a front lever back to the starting position. The slower the better.

Jack Knives to prone I - Complete an initial jackknife movement and then extend backward with your feet reaching away from your hands so arms extend above your head.

V-Ups - Slow and steady movements are key in this exercise and try to keep straight arms and legs
